Provident Estate is proud to present (1) One-bedroom apartment in Prime Views in the heart of Meydan.

Kitchen:

-Blender
-Pans & Pots
-Nescafe machine with coffee capsules
-Microwave
-Washing machine
-Refrigerator
-Villeroy & Boch wine glasses
-Drinking glasses
-Mugs
-Plates, Forks, Spoons, Knives
-Flower vases
-Cleaning supplies
-Water dispenser (with heating and cooling functions)

Living Room & Dining Area:

-Spacious shoe cabinet
-Large sofa bed (suitable for two adults and one child)
-Dyson vacuum cleaner with interchangeable filters
-Steam cleaner (floor sanitizing machine)
-Cleaning supplies

Bedroom:

-Vanity unit with mirror and lighting and jewelry drawer
-Xiaomi robot vacuum cleaner
-Hair dryer with round brush
-Hair straightener
-Hair curling iron
-Large built-in wardrobe with integrated laundry storage
-Storage systems (including space for suitcases)
-Iron
-Ironing board
-Step ladder
 
Balcony:

-Clothes drying rack
-2 chairs & 1 coffee table

For more details and Viewing, please contact us

Prime Views, Meydan Avenue offers an unparalleled living experience with stunning, panoramic vistas of Dubai’s skyline and conveniently located in middle of Dubai. This stylish 2-bedroom apartment combines luxury with convenience, featuring high-end furnishings and modern finishes. Located in the heart of Meydan Avenue, enjoy proximity to world-class amenities, fine dining, and easy access to major attractions. Live in a space that blends comfort, elegance, and an unbeatable view.
